description:
PureSync, a file and folder synchronization and backup tool, by Jumping Bytes

PureSync is a free Windows utility for file/folder synchronization, backup, and secure transfer, offering automatic background operations, multi-protocol support (FTP/MTP/network), and intuitive comparison tools, with a paid Professional Edition for advanced commercial needs

Synchronization & Backup:
- Automatic sync/backup triggered by schedules, file changes, or USB connections.
- Supports real-time updates, incremental backups, and conflict resolution 

Protocol Support:
- Works with local/network drives, FTP, NAS, and MTP devices (e.g., cameras/phones)

Advanced Tools:
- Side-by-side comparison for verifying changes pre-sync.
- Shadow Copy Explorer
- various filters to exclude files/types.
